hwinfo.note: Check the HWiNFO commercial-use terms for customer work; free personal availability does not establish a technician-use license.

everything.note: These links are for the stable Everything desktop application, not the separately licensed Everything Server product.

defender-business.note: Follow the licensed organization’s onboarding method. Windows protection is integrated; organizational onboarding packages and other-platform clients depend on the deployment.

metadefender-cloud.note: Free community access with quotas; paid plans add private scan and private processing options. A free account increases community limits and provides history; advanced processing depends on plan.

jotti.note: Free web scanning; the current page lists five simultaneous files and a 250 MB per-file limit. The public upload page does not require a sign-in step.

hybrid-analysis.note: Free community service; commercial Falcon Sandbox is a separate offering. Use a service account for submission/API capabilities; exact access level is shown by the current portal.

anyrun.note: Free Community personal plan with restricted environments and runtime; paid Hunter and Enterprise plans add capabilities and private analyses. Registration is required for creating analysis tasks.

triage.note: Free public individual/researcher accounts for noncommercial use; private enterprise service is commercial. A public account is needed to submit; researcher permissions provide additional API and rule capabilities.

joe-sandbox.note: Cloud Basic is free for noncommercial research with limited analyses/output; Cloud Pro supports private and commercial analysis. Sign in before submitting a sample; viewing the form alone does not grant submission access.

intezer-analyze.note: Current enterprise plans are quoted by endpoint coverage. A current free community scan allowance was not established in this review. An Intezer account and the capabilities assigned to it are required.

polyswarm.note: Free Community account with limited functionality and quotas; paid plans and private communities are separate. Limited anonymous functionality; a free account unlocks Community features.

filescan-io.note: Free community service with limited report/configuration and API quotas; commercial Aether products provide additional controls. Use the public web portal; account/API requirements depend on the operation.

unpacme.note: Free Public tier is noncommercial and public-only; paid researcher/professional plans include additional quotas and private submissions. Sign in for account quotas, saved work and paid/private capabilities.

kaspersky-opentip.note: Free basic/community access; premium intelligence and full reports require a subscription. Anonymous use returns basic information; a Kaspersky account adds history, private requests and more detail.

urlscan.note: Free community service with quotas; paid plans add hunting, feeds and advanced capabilities. Public search is available without sign-in; accounts provide API keys and personal/team capabilities.

urlhaus.note: Public web database; automated feeds and API access have separate fair-use/commercial terms. Public browsing and lookup; contribution and automation features use the provider’s account/authentication workflow.

malwarebazaar.note: Free public database; commercial automation may require an enhanced API subscription. Public search; authentication and provider terms apply to contribution/download/API operations.

threatfox.note: Free community web access; commercial API usage may need the enhanced subscription. Public database browsing; contributions and API calls use the provider’s account/authentication workflow.

yaraify.note: Community web service; provider account and API terms govern advanced use. Custom rules and live hunts require an abuse.ch account; nonpublic Malpedia matches require a linked Malpedia key.

no-more-ransom.note: Free identification resources and supported decryptor links. The official identification route is public; no account requirement was stated in the reviewed instructions.

id-ransomware.note: Free public service. Public form; no account is required by the visible workflow.

checkphish.note: Free initial URL scan; signup expands scans and API options; Bolster commercial plans are separate. Initial public scan is offered; additional scans and automation require signup.
